themes.description: Users are complaining about various issues with booking FDs, including missing or misleading information, incorrect calculations, and inability to reinvest or redeem FDs. Some users also report being misled by promotions and offers. Additionally, there are issues with VKYC approval, delayed crediting of FDs, and unresponsive customer support.
themes.business_impact: Delayed crediting of FDs results in loss of interest, missed opportunities for reinvestment, and a negative customer experience. Incorrect calculations and misleading information can lead to financial losses and mistrust of the platform.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The root cause of these issues is likely due to a lack of clear communication, inadequate design and testing of user flows, and insufficient training of customer support staff.
themes.action_plan: • Improve clarity and accuracy of FD booking information, enhance VKYC approval process, and provide clear and transparent communication about FD maturity and redemption. Train customer support staff to respond promptly and effectively to customer inquiries, and implement a robust system for handling technical issues.

themes.description: Users report struggling to get assistance from customer support, with issues not being resolved, long wait times, and difficulty in connecting with representatives.
themes.business_impact: Customers are wasting significant time and have unmet expectations, which can lead to a negative brand image and potential loss of business.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: Inefficient support process, inadequate training, or insufficient staffing levels might be contributing to the poor customer support experience.
themes.action_plan: • Implement a more efficient support process, provide comprehensive training to support staff, and increase staffing levels to ensure timely assistance and issue resolution.

They promised me a date on which refund should have been credited. but did not received money for days

themes.description: Users experience difficulty in withdrawing their money, with some even reporting loss of funds due to technical glitches and poor customer support.
themes.business_impact: High financial risk of losing users' money, damaging brand reputation, and potential lawsuits.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: Inadequate or non-existent system checks for accurate transaction processing, coupled with lack of effective customer support.
themes.action_plan: • Implement additional system checks for accurate transaction processing, enhance customer support with dedicated teams for resolving fund withdrawal issues, and provide clear communication to users regarding their account status and any issues.
